content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The three prerequisites record the answers this edge uses: where the marker file is and what its one fixed place forecloses (ysqqrqsp), which working copy holds the stack, that a landing draws exactly one bracket there and that draft-side work is not bracketed (uqqswnsy), and which invocations bracket at all — creation, recording and removal and no fourth verb (vwlrqoxk). The dependent is a requirement sentence, which the matrix classes as the structured layer, so the edge is the natural→structured cell; that cell's check is the natural→natural gate form copied here — non-violation only — and a requirement-sentence child adds no observable to demand. No repository path carries the check — no artifact is licensed for this unit and a requirement sentence has no machine surface — so a reviewer reads the recorded dependent against the three nodes clause by clause and fails every element that departs from what they state, naming the element and the prerequisite it contradicts. The criterion names no element of either endpoint and no requirement of the dependent, so rewording the requirement without changing what it decides leaves the gate intact, and the check presupposes no decision outside the three recorded here.
